name: Spirit of Dark Magic
effect:
2 cards whose names are, or that mention, "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos", including at least 1 Fusion or Ritual Monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned by returning the above cards from your hand or field to the Deck (you do not use "Polymerization"), and cannot be Fusion Summoned by other ways.
This card is treated as "Dark Magician" while on the field or in the Graveyard.
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell Card from your Deck or GY to your hand that mentions "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in its text. You can only activate this effect of “Spirit of Dark Magic”  twice per turn. If this card is sent to the GY or banished: You can add 1 “Secrets of Dark Magic” or "Ultimate Fusion" from your Deck, GY, or that is banished to your hand. You can only use this effect of “Spirit of Dark Magic” once per turn.
While this card is on your field, you can activate Quick-Play spell cards from your hand during your opponent's turn.
